snippet.title: Draggin - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try the demo - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694970/Draggin_Demo/
Wishlist the full game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475110/Draggin/

Fight draggins by draggin' the mouse in the demo for this cutesy arcade style bullet-hell! Click-and-drag to cast spells on your enemies and get your fill of wave battlin', achievement huntin', upgrade unlockin', rinse-and-repeatin'!

Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/draggingame.bsky.social
Tiktok - https://www.tiktok.com/@draggin.game

Alagard font by Hewett Tsoi
